def run(_context):
    import mb_cam as mb
    import json

    # 1. Tool Selection
    # Face mill: Fly cutter (idx 4)
    # Roughing/Finishing Endmill: 1/2" Flat Endmill (idx 14) - 12.7mm
    # Small pocket/detail: 1/4" (not found in snippet, let's use 5/16" idx 15)
    
    t_face = mb.add_tool('toollibraryroot://Local/TIW CNC Tool Library (4-28-26)', 4)["document_tool_index"]
    t_rough = mb.add_tool('toollibraryroot://Local/TIW CNC Tool Library (4-28-26)', 14)["document_tool_index"]
    t_detail = mb.add_tool('toollibraryroot://Local/TIW CNC Tool Library (4-28-26)', 15)["document_tool_index"]

    # 2. Facing Operation
    # Face the top (Z=49.53 is the top face centroid's Z in my inspection, but we have 1mm stock)
    # Setup1 is already there.
    op_face = mb.add_operation("Setup1", strategy="face", tool=t_face, name="Facing")
    mb.set_params(op_face["operation"], {
        "stepover": {"value": 20, "unit": "mm"},
        "maximumStepdown": {"value": 0.5, "unit": "mm"},
        "tool_feedCutting": {"value": 1000, "unit": "mm"},
        "tool_spindleSpeed": {"value": 2000, "unit": "raw"},
    })

    # 3. Roughing the outer contour
    # The top face (idx 14) is the boundary.
    op_rough = mb.add_operation("Setup1", strategy="adaptive2d", tool=t_rough, 
                                geometry={"faces": [14], "type": "contour", "loop": "OnlyOutsideLoops", "side": "AlwaysOutsideSideType"},
                                name="Rough_Outer")
    # We need to set the bottom height to the part bottom.
    # The part dimensions are ~127x19x49.5. Bottom is Z=0.
    mb.set_params(op_rough["operation"], {
        "optimalLoad": {"value": 2.0, "unit": "mm"},
        "maximumStepdown": {"value": 10.0, "unit": "mm"},
        "tool_feedCutting": {"value": 1200, "unit": "mm"},
        "tool_spindleSpeed": {"value": 5000, "unit": "raw"},
        "bottomHeight_mode": {"value": "bottomPlane", "unit": "choice"},
        "bottomHeight_offset": {"value": 0, "unit": "mm"}
    })

    # 4. Finishing the outer contour
    op_finish = mb.add_operation("Setup1", strategy="contour2d", tool=t_rough,
                                 geometry={"faces": [14], "type": "contour", "loop": "OnlyOutsideLoops", "side": "AlwaysOutsideSideType"},
                                 name="Finish_Outer")
    mb.set_params(op_finish["operation"], {
        "stepdown": {"value": 50, "unit": "mm"}, # Full depth in one go or multiple
        "tool_feedCutting": {"value": 600, "unit": "mm"},
        "tool_spindleSpeed": {"value": 5000, "unit": "raw"},
        "bottomHeight_mode": {"value": "bottomPlane", "unit": "choice"},
        "bottomHeight_offset": {"value": 0, "unit": "mm"}
    })

    # Generate all
    res = mb.generate(setup="Setup1")
    print(json.dumps(res))
